editorial:
Imagine being a teenager with no place to go and everyone telling you that you are a failure. That is exactly where you find the crew in this story. You get to follow Yoshiie Hiroyuki and a group of other tough kids who all dropped out of school. They get a second chance when a high school in Hokkaido decides to take them in, even though they have a reputation for being troublemakers. The vibe is a mix of heavy emotion and hope, as you watch these kids try to figure out who they want to be while dealing with their messy pasts. It is a real heart-tugger that shows how hard it is to change your life when the world expects you to fail.

What really hits home is the bond between the students and the teachers who refuse to give up on them. The acting feels real and raw, making the emotional outbursts feel genuine rather than forced. While the pacing slows down in a few spots, the payoff is totally worth it. If you love stories about underdogs and redemption, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with the students finally finding a sense of belonging and purpose. After fighting through their anger and personal demons, they manage to graduate together. You see them transform from scared, angry kids into young adults with actual goals. The final scenes focus on the lasting impact the teachers had on their lives, proving that a little bit of faith and kindness can actually save someone from a dark path.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about second chances and overcoming the odds.
